_comment: Guided tour for the micro-time shifter. Targets: by name for the app's own buttons and rects (add_files, channel_shifts, histogram), by attr for the spec fields (trigger_level, trigger_position) and by name for the spec button actions (auto_align, save_dialog, register), which are not section keys. Read by chisurf.emtk.help_guide.

steps.title: One time axis for every detector
steps.text: Cables and electronics delay each detector differently, so the same photon arrives at a different micro-time on each. This tool shifts each routing channel's micro-times (cyclically, modulo the bin count) until the rising edges coincide, and writes shifted copies.

steps.title: Queue the files
steps.text: Add TTTR files, a folder, or datasets from the database — or drop them on the window. All must have the same number of micro-time bins; the preview sums them by routing channel.

await.hint: Press ➕ Files… and pick a photon file.

steps.title: The rising edges
steps.text: Each detector's histogram, with the yellow threshold and the green target bin. The first bin up to a peak that reaches the threshold is that detector's rising edge. Drag either line; alignment runs when you let go.

steps.title: Threshold
steps.text: Pick it where the edges are steep: below the background the edge becomes the first bin, above the peak it falls back to the peak.

steps.title: Target bin
steps.text: Where every rising edge should land.

steps.title: Align
steps.text: Each channel's shift becomes (shift + target − edge) mod N.

steps.title: The shifts
steps.text: One row per routing channel, plus the global shift that moves them all. Edit a row to fine-tune; ↺ Reset sets it back to zero.

steps.title: Write the shifted files
steps.text: One file: name the copy. Several: choose a folder. The inputs are never changed.

steps.title: Or archive them
steps.text:
With a database configured, the shifted files go into the object store with their inputs and shifts as provenance, under the sample you choose.

The ? button has the details.
